api_change: EventKind::Text now owns oriole::Text rather than allocator String. Read-only access preserved; mutation consumers use a separate buffer and freeze once. Full note in API.md.

limitations: Shared host CPU frequency and other load uncontrolled.
Reported ratios are medians of paired ratios; do not divide separate medians to reproduce them.
Outside reference-heavy parsing measured differences are near noise, including ~2%long-text64 regression.
Hardware sampling unavailable because perf_event_paranoid=4; allocation attribution and paired timings only.

post_asan_changes: Only linear core-test coalescing and streaming-fuzzer adaptation; both checked. Runtime source unchanged.
recommendation: Integrate the immutable character-data-only Text layer after combined consumer and differential gates; reject the earlier global inline String variants.
review: Independent multibyte_fuzz review found no ownership, UTF8, callback, normalization or resource-budget blocker; root review/integration decision remains pending.
One new unchecked UTF8 conversion is confined to immutable Text in storage; input constructors accept complete str and private length is bounded23.
Raw pointers into inline Text become invalid if its owner moves. C dispatch finalizes the owner in one local before pointer capture and does not move it during callback.
Heap storage retains allocator provenance; inline variants allocate nothing and expose no growth API.
Physical CR normalization retains its previous fallible allocator path; entity-source numeric CR remains literal.
Family callback/expansion byte accounting and enclosing object sizes remain unchanged.

validation.clippy_all_targets: core/storage/FFI pass; all five fuzz targets pass
